clocktower.role.greedy_courtier.name: Courtier
clocktower.role.greedy_courtier.desc: Twice per game, at night, choose a different character: they are drunk for 3 nights & 3 days.
clocktower.role.greedy_cult_leader.name: Cult Leader
clocktower.role.greedy_cult_leader.desc: Each night, you become the alignment of an alive neighbour. If all good players choose to join your cult, your team wins. If you die at night, become good.
clocktower.role.greedy_engineer.name: Engineer
clocktower.role.greedy_engineer.desc: Once per game, during the day, visit the Storyteller to learn a number of in play Minion or Demon characters equal to the Day.
clocktower.role.greedy_huntsman.name: Huntsman
clocktower.role.greedy_huntsman.desc: You start knowing an in play Outsider. They can't change character from other abilities. Once per game, at night, choose a player: that Outsider, if chosen, becomes a not in play good Townsfolk. [+0 or +1 Outsider]
clocktower.role.greedy_mayor.name: Mayor
clocktower.role.greedy_mayor.desc: If only 3 players live (travellers don't count) & no execution occurs, your team wins. If you die at night, another player might die instead.
clocktower.role.greedy_philosopher.name: Philosopher
clocktower.role.greedy_philosopher.desc: Once per game, at night, choose a good character: gain that ability. You may be told to reconsider. If you pick a character that's not helpful to your team or ruins the games balance 3 times, you become Drunk.
clocktower.role.greedy_poppy_grower.name: Poppy Grower
clocktower.role.greedy_poppy_grower.desc: Minions & Demons do not know each other. If you die, even if drunk or poisoned, they learn who each other are at night.
clocktower.role.greedy_soldier.name: Soldier
clocktower.role.greedy_soldier.desc: You are safe from the Demon. Each night, if your ability protected you from the Demon, wake and learn this.
clocktower.role.greedy_hatter.name: Hatter
clocktower.role.greedy_hatter.desc: If you die, at night, choose Minions or Demons. All players of the type you chose picks new characters of the same type to be.
clocktower.role.greedy_heretic.name: Heretic
clocktower.role.greedy_heretic.desc: Whoever wins, loses, & whoever loses, wins. If only evil players are alive, evil wins (therefore good wins). This ability works even if you are dead.
clocktower.role.greedy_hermit.name: Hermit
clocktower.role.greedy_hermit.desc: You have 3 Outsider abilities. You know each, even if drunk or poisoned. [-0 or -1 Outsiders]
clocktower.role.greedy_lunatic.name: Lunatic
clocktower.role.greedy_lunatic.desc: You think you are a Demon, but you are not. The Demon knows who you are & who you choose at night.
clocktower.role.greedy_recluse.name: Recluse
clocktower.role.greedy_recluse.desc: You might register as any character, alignment, or living status, even if dead.
clocktower.role.greedy_snitch.name: Snitch
clocktower.role.greedy_snitch.desc: Each Minion starts knowing a different in-play good character.
clocktower.role.greedy_sweetheart.name: Sweetheart
clocktower.role.greedy_sweetheart.desc: When you die, 1 player is drunk from now on. When dead, you may guess (once) which. If correct, all players learn you are the Sweetheart tonight.
clocktower.role.greedy_pit_hag.name: Pit-Hag
clocktower.role.greedy_pit_hag.desc: Each other night*, you may choose a player & character they become (if not in play). If a potential evil-making character or Demon is made, deaths tonight are arbitrary.
clocktower.role.greedy_psychopath.name: Psychopath
clocktower.role.greedy_psychopath.desc: If there are 5 or more alive players (not including travellers), each day, before nominations, you may publicly choose a player: they die. If executed, you only die if you lose roshambo.
clocktower.role.greedy_summoner.name: Summoner
clocktower.role.greedy_summoner.desc: On the 3rd night, choose a player: they become an evil Demon of your choice. [No Demon]
clocktower.role.greedy_wizard.name: Wizard
clocktower.role.greedy_wizard.desc: Once per game, choose to make a wish. If granted, it might have a price & leave a clue as to its nature. If you propose a declined wish for your team 3 times, you turn into a character of the same type.
clocktower.role.greedy_kazali.name: Kazali
clocktower.role.greedy_kazali.desc: Each night*, choose a player: they die. [You choose which players are which Minions, your Minion choices may be denied. -? to +? Outsiders]
